text:
pm-ryan: quick sync from the postmortem 1 - we need a single 'streaming stability bridge' to own fixes for timeouts, partial responses, and reconnect logic until we verify no regressions for 14 days. main asks: owners, short-term mitigations, alerts, and CI tests.

Sanjay: i can own client reconnect behavior and the reconnect lib. i'll do an exponential backoff with jitter and ensure KV cache resume is safe.

Maria: i'll own detection for partial responses. plan: add metric partial_chunk_detected and a Prom rule that pages on sustained spikes. dashboard + heatmap by region.

Elaine: i'll handle routing policy/fallback model wiring. prefer same-region quantized variant as fallback to avoid cross-region penalties.

Ken: i'll consolidate the runbook steps, include exact rollback commands, and own the canary plan for the reconnect lib.

pm-ryan: concrete tasks:
- RED-8001 SANJAY: reconnect lib + unit tests + CI harness 1 ETA Tue
- RED-8002 MARIA: partial_chunk_detected metric + alert rule 1 ETA Thu EOD
- RED-8003 ELAINE: routing fallback config + capacity notes 1 ETA Fri
- RED-8004 KEN: consolidated runbook + canary playbook 1 ETA Mon
- RED-8005 SANJAY: test harness for simulated dropped-final-chunk scenarios 1 ETA Wed

Sanjay: implementation note: backoff_ms = [150, 400, 900, 1800], cap 2s, add random jitter +-20%. will not retry more than 4 times by default.

Maria: alert idea: if partial_chunk_detected > 3/min for 2m in prod, create P0 ticket and notify "streaming-bridge" channel. staging/dev lower thresholds.

Elaine: fallback behavior: when a partial response is detected, server should attempt an internal retry on a fallback model preserving conversation id and KV token. if fallback succeeds, respond to client with aggregated chunks and an "X-Fallback-Used" header.

Ken: runbook short steps: 1) detect partial_chunk spike 2) trigger automated retry to fallback 3) mark incident & create RED ticket 4) if rate > threshold, scale capacity and engage oncall. i'll add commands and sample logs.

pm-ryan: let's add prefilled ticket creation from alerts including request_id, session_id, instance_id, and first_last_chunk_indexes. reduces triage time.

Sanjay: i'll add a small client shim to log those fields and ensure we don't double-bill tokens after reconnect. tests will assert token accounting.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: staging reconnect-lib v0.9.2 by Sanjay. CI green. scheduled 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z.

ops-bot: recurring calendar created: "Streaming Stability Bridge" Mon/Wed 30m starting 2026-03-30. invites sent.

Maria: i'll add dashboard panels: partial chunk rate, reconnect rate, successful fallback rate. tag by model and region.

Elaine: i'll surface capacity delta estimates to finance once fallback numbers are measured.

pm-ryan: follow-ups: owners update RED tickets with acceptance criteria + tests today; Ken posts runbook link; reconvene next Tue for rollup.

Sanjay: ack, updating RED-8001/8005 now. will post PR link.

Maria: ack. pairing welcome for dashboard work.

Ken: ack, will publish runbook to docs/incident-runbooks and link here.

pm-ryan: thanks everyone. this thread is canonical for the remediation bridge until 14 clean days. escalate to P0 if any spike. :rocket:
